title: Isoliquiritigenin ameliorates Pseudomonas aeruginosa-induced acute lung injury through inhibiting lung epithelial cell ferroptosis via PPARgamma/Nrf2/GPX4 axis.
authors: Cao, Honglei; Yu, Meng; Tang, Siqi; He, Yanfeng; Wu, Meng; Pang, Zheng
one_liner_zh: 该文研究异甘草素通过PPARγ/Nrf2/GPX4轴抑制肺上皮细胞铁死亡缓解铜绿假单胞菌所致急性肺损伤，核心为疾病机制与药物作用，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，且方法以实验为主，仅含少量分子对接模拟，与本课题无关。
abstract: Pseudomonas aeruginosa, an opportunistic pathogen, is a primary cause of acute lung injury (ALI) and acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) in immunocompromised individuals. Isoliquiritigenin (ISL), a natural flavonoid primarily found in liquorice (Glycyrrhiza glabra), has demonstrated protective effects against infection-induced ALI. However, the therapeutic potential and molecular mechanisms of ISL against P. aeruginosa-induced ALI remain unclear. In this study, we established a mouse model of acute bacterial pneumonia and an in vitro lung epithelial cell infection model to assess the therapeutic efficacy and underlying mechanisms of ISL. Results showed that ISL improved the survival and alleviated the P. aeruginosa-induced ALI in mice by reducing neutrophil recruitment, pulmonary cell death and bacterial load. Transcriptomic and enrichment analyses revealed that ISL reversed infection-induced inflammation and oxidative stress, while also providing supporting evidence for ferroptosis-related alterations. Moreover, ISL treatment significantly preserved the structural and functional integrity of the pulmonary epithelial barrier by attenuating pulmonary edema, reducing pulmonary epithelial permeability, and restoring tight junction protein expression. Network pharmacology identified AKT1, EGFR, PPARG and COX-2 as candidate targets of ISL. SPR, molecular docking and molecular dynamics simulation further verified the interaction between ISL and PPARgamma. Subsequent mechanistic investigations demonstrated that ISL activated the PPARgamma/Nrf2/GPX4 signaling axis and inhibited lung epithelial cell ferroptosis both in vivo and in vitro. Altogether, ISL protects against P. aeruginosa-induced ALI by activating PPARgamma/Nrf2/GPX4 axis and suppressing lung epithelial cell ferroptosis, thereby preserving lung epithelial barrier integrity and reducing inflammatory responses.
abstract_zh: 铜绿假单胞菌（Pseudomonas aeruginosa）作为一种机会性病原体，是免疫功能低下个体发生急性肺损伤（ALI）和急性呼吸窘迫综合征（ARDS）的主要原因。异甘草素（ISL），一种主要存在于甘草（Glycyrrhiza glabra）中的天然黄酮类化合物，已显示出对感染诱导的ALI具有保护作用。然而，ISL对抗铜绿假单胞菌诱导的ALI的治疗潜力及分子机制仍不清楚。在本研究中，我们建立了急性细菌性肺炎小鼠模型和体外肺上皮细胞感染模型，以评估ISL的治疗效果及其潜在机制。结果表明，ISL通过减少中性粒细胞募集、肺细胞死亡和细菌载量，改善了小鼠的存活率并减轻了铜绿假单胞菌诱导的ALI。转录组学和富集分析显示，ISL逆转了感染诱导的炎症和氧化应激，同时为铁死亡相关变化提供了支持性证据。此外，ISL治疗通过减轻肺水肿、降低肺上皮通透性和恢复紧密连接蛋白表达，显著保持了肺上皮屏障的结构和功能完整性。网络药理学鉴定出AKT1、EGFR、PPARG和COX-2为ISL的候选靶点。SPR、分子对接和分子动力学模拟进一步验证了ISL与PPARgamma之间的相互作用。随后的机制研究表明，ISL在体内和体外均激活了PPARgamma/Nrf2/GPX4信号轴，并抑制了肺上皮细胞铁死亡。总之，ISL通过激活PPARgamma/Nrf2/GPX4轴并抑制肺上皮细胞铁死亡，从而保护肺上皮屏障完整性并减少炎症反应，对抗铜绿假单胞菌诱导的ALI。
